mapper.sql: select id, project_id, scheme_id, apply_time, contact, phone, email, template_id, attach_id, vendor_range, create_by, create_id, create_time, update_by, update_id, update_time, del_flag, notice_status, is_open_people, is_eval, wf_process_id from tb_tender_notice
mapper.select:
SELECT ps.procurement_scheme_code, ps.procurement_scheme_name, ps.price_type, ps.subject_matter_type, bi.id biddingInfoId, bi.twice_quot, su.thrid_org_name unit, tn.scheme_id, tn.id noticeId , tn.create_time, tn.contact, tn.apply_time, tn.notice_status, tn.vendor_range, tn.phone, CASE WHEN bi.id is null or bi.id = '' THEN '未投标' ELSE '已投标' END bidStatus
FROM tb_tender_notice tn left join tb_tender_notice_range tnr on tnr.notice_id = tn.id and tnr.del_flag = 0 and tnr.type = 1 left join tb_procurement_scheme ps on ps.id = tn.scheme_id and ps.del_flag = 0 left join tb_bidding_info bi on bi.notice_id = tn.id and bi.del_flag = 0 and bi.parent_id is null and bi.vendor_id = #{queryDTO.vendorId} left join sys_user su on su.user_id = ps.procurement_officer
tn.del_flag = 0 and tn.notice_status != 0 and ( CASE WHEN ps.procurement_type != 1 and tn.vendor_range = 1 THEN tnr.vendor_id = #{queryDTO.vendorId} ELSE 1 END) = 1
and ps.procurement_scheme_name like CONCAT('%', #{queryDTO.procurementSchemeName}, '%')
and ps.procurement_scheme_code = #{queryDTO.procurementSchemeCode}
and ps.procurement_type = 1
and ps.procurement_type != 1
order by tn.create_time desc

SELECT ps.procurement_scheme_code, ps.procurement_scheme_name, tn.create_time, tn.notice_status, tn.id noticeId, tn.scheme_id, br.publicity_start_time, br.publicity_end_time, su.thrid_org_name unit FROM tb_tender_notice tn LEFT JOIN tb_procurement_scheme ps ON ps.id = tn.scheme_id AND ps.del_flag = 0 inner join tb_bidding_result br ON br.notice_id = tn.id and br.scheme_id = tn.scheme_id left join sys_user su on su.user_id = ps.procurement_officer where tn.del_flag = 0 and tn.notice_status >= #{queryDTO.noticeStatus} and br.publicity_start_time is not null and br.publicity_end_time is not null and br.rank = 1
and ps.procurement_plan_type = #{queryDTO.procurementPlanType}
and ps.procurement_scheme_name like CONCAT('%', #{queryDTO.procurementSchemeName}, '%')
order by tn.create_time desc

select tn.*, ps.procurement_type schemeType, ps.procurement_scheme_name as procurementSchemeName, ps.project_code as projectCode from tb_tender_notice tn inner join tb_procurement_scheme ps on ps.id = tn.scheme_id where tn.id = #{id} and tn.del_flag = 0 and ps.del_flag = 0
